scope: Correct impossible raw-argument native declarations without changing stable IDs or business expectations.

expectedUnchanged: Layout validation rejects the duplicate ID.
corrections.rationale: addColumn always generates a fresh crypto.randomUUID; the column form exposes no identifier input and reorder/remove retain that generated identity. A duplicate raw ID can only be constructed outside native controls.

expectedUnchanged: Layout validation refuses the foreign stage.
corrections.rationale: loadWorkflows/loadStages retrieve choices from the current project and chooseStages receives only scoped picker option IDs; no raw or foreign stage input exists.

expectedUnchanged: Layout validation refuses an empty board.
corrections.rationale: removeColumn refuses when fewer than two columns remain, and the native Remove column button is disabled for the final column. Native controls cannot submit an empty column array.

expectedUnchanged: The protected default name is retained.
corrections.rationale: Default-board name input is readonly. Raw attempted name mutation is a service rejection contract; a separate native readonly assertion can cover the UI boundary.

expectedUnchanged: The unrestricted default saved view is retained.
corrections.rationale: Saved view editor is rendered only for nondefault boards, so the native default-board flow cannot construct a restricted savedFilters mutation.
Native rank buttons derive a distinct adjacent loaded row, and drag ignores an unchanged index; no self-anchor input exists.
corrections.nativeCounterpart: Native prevention controls are tested separately when independently specified; this service rejection is not credited from an injected browser HTTP call.

expectedUnchanged: Only current backlog work can be ranked.
corrections.rationale: Native backlog ranking controls are rendered only for current planned rows, so an active issue cannot be chosen as the subject through native controls.
corrections.nativeCounterpart: Native prevention controls are tested separately when independently specified; this service rejection is not credited from an injected browser HTTP call.

corrections.rationale: The native backlog endpoint and ranked list exclude archived work; archived subject IDs cannot be supplied by any native ranking control.
corrections.nativeCounterpart: Native prevention controls are tested separately when independently specified; this service rejection is not credited from an injected browser HTTP call.

expectedUnchanged: The anchor must be a current backlog issue.
corrections.rationale: Native rank neighbors come only from the current project backlog rows. Active board anchors cannot be supplied by a native rank action.
corrections.nativeCounterpart: Native prevention controls are tested separately when independently specified; this service rejection is not credited from an injected browser HTTP call.

expectedUnchanged: The anchor is unavailable in this scoped operation.
corrections.rationale: Native rank neighbors are scoped to the one project backlog; a foreign project anchor is not available as a native input.
corrections.nativeCounterpart: Native prevention controls are tested separately when independently specified; this service rejection is not credited from an injected browser HTTP call.

corrections.rationale: Archive/Restore controls render only when !view.board.default; native users cannot submit a default-board archive command.
